id.description: A unique identifier for the paging group.

name.description: Unique name for the paging group. Minimum length is 1. Maximum length is 30.

phoneNumber.description: Paging group phone number. Minimum length is 1. Maximum length is 23. Either `phoneNumber` or `extension` is mandatory.

extension.description: Paging group extension. Minimum length is 2. Maximum length is 10. Either `phoneNumber` or `extension` is mandatory.

esn.description: Routing prefix + extension of a person or workspace.

locationName.description: Name of location for paging group.

locationId.description: Id of location for paging group.

tollFreeNumber.description: Flag to indicate toll free number.
